messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a v2 cutover tonight in the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Need to freeze client-facing schema changes and confirm rollback criteria + release-note blurb. @Devon @Sameer can you weigh in?
Devon: Ack. Infra good for that window. We need a pinlist for mobile SDKs and a short how-to for SDK owners. Where is the deploybot job?
deploybot: deploybot created a scheduled cutover job (id cb-2026-03-21-01). Start ts=1719999001. Dry-run scheduled 21:45 UTC. Reply with `deploybot confirm cb-2026-03-21-01` to proceed.
Sameer: Important: v2 will prefer a normalized header `x-api-version`. Older SDKs sometimes send `X-API-Version` (capitalization). Recommend backward-compatible header handling at the proxy: accept both and prefer explicit query param if present.
Kelsey: We have an edge shim ready. Can toggle `edge://feature/api-v2-shim=true` for a quiet ramp to translate headers. Suggest enabling for canary.
Nikhil: Rollback criteria proposal: sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR error spike from clients tagged `legacy_client` OR p50 latency > 300ms for 10m. Also auto-wedge on deploybot if deploy fails healthchecks x3.
Sarah: I added a short blurb to release notes under "behavior changes": explain header fallback and how to pin to v1. Link: https://go/release-notes/v2-cutover (internal). Also included `--compat-mode` flag guidance.
Ops: Operator checklist updated in the runbook. Plan: start at 5% canary for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then full flip if stable. Deploybot will auto-wedge and notify `#incidents` on spike.
Maria: Can we add mobile SDK owners to the pinlist before canary? @Devon please add android-team + ios-team. Also double-check that pinned clients remain routed to v1.
Devon: Done — android-team and ios-team added to pinlist. Confirmed pinned traffic stays on pool `pool-v1-000`. Adding a short note for SDK owners on how to pin: `X-Client-Pin: v1` header.
talbot: talbot (srebot) here — alerting/playbook attached in the checklist. If rollback is required run `deploybot rollback cb-2026-03-21-01 --force` then route traffic back to `pool-v1-000`. Confirm that metrics dashboards have the legacy_client tag visible.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary initiated — routing 5% traffic to v2. Monitoring enabled. Pinned clients remain on v1. Watch `#eng-sre` and telemetry dashboards.
Maria: 👍 watching the first 15m closely. If all good we ramp +20m intervals as per checklist. If anyone sees legacy SDK errors, add screenshots + request immediate pause.
Devon: Quick note — mobile teams requested an explicit example for pinning (added to release notes). Also added a short troubleshooting FAQ for header case-sensitivity.
Kelsey: Edge shim is toggled for canary. No protocol errors in proxy logs so far.
Nikhil: Observability: added a temporary alert rule to fire on 3x baseline client errors from legacy_client within 10m.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short follow-up once we hit 30m and decide next ramp step.
